title: C lollipop comparators diverge from Rust/Python across multi-step wraps — port Rust 7-bit serial-arithmetic form
description: rpl_dao_build.c:52-110 + dodag.c:38-84 accept only |a−b|≤16 straight-line plus {0,127} special case. Rust routing.rs:63-89 seq_is_newer uses regional serial arithmetic accepting e.g. incoming=5/current=120 (13 steps across 127→0 restart), 130/250, ≤16 past circular→linear wrap. C returns INCOMPARABLE→REJECTED: breaks repo identical-output rule; adversary inducing ~16 path_sequence increments strands target routes at C roots (~116-increment climb-back) while Rust peers update. Fail-closed (no replay-as-newer) but partitionable. Fix: port Rust formulation verbatim + shared wrap-boundary vectors (127→0 multi-step, 255→0, ±17 past wrap). Covers version_is_newer too.
